events.title: Beazer Stock Soars More Than 30% On Takeover Bid From Dream Finders
events.body: Homebuilder Beazer Home surged after an unsolicited takeover offer from one of its largest shareholders Dream Finders Home. The offer includes a 40% premium for the stock.

events.title: Beazer Homes (BZH) Shares Surge After Dream Finders Launches Buyout Proposal
events.body: Beazer Homes USA (NYSE:BZH) shares jumped 20% on Monday after Dream Finders Homes (NYSE:DFH) publicly proposed acquiring the homebuilder in an all-cash deal valued at $25. 75 per share.
